source_authority: Only a typed source-bound GameEnvironmentRequest using installed-libretro or original in-process DMG ROM is eligible; explicit operator assertion of rights required; no forged human demonstration issuer
application_scope: Runs actual emulator steps, audits reversibility, and only then commits real tabular Q-learning updates
counterfactual_execution: Saved emulator state -> actual alternative action -> measured reward/frame -> restore original; cannot train from unrecorded hypothetical transition
multi_controller: Explicit alternate combined buttons, two-port and four-port actual libretro input_step probes, read-only measurements; marked controller-only and excluded from Q policy updates
reverse_evidence: For every run record multiple actual state snapshots; replay each suffix in reverse checkpoint order; require exact per-transition observation/reward/native evidence and final snapshot identity prior to training
boomerang: Randomized seeded intervals and reservoir-preserved older runs; recreate approved host and replay saved original actual-state traces. Revisits never count as newly learned episodes or Q updates.
saturation: After at least 10 consecutive actually measured runs without both new coarse visual signatures and new Q states or material Q-value movement above 1e-6, terminate with observed_q_and_visual_learning_plateau; this does not establish global learning convergence.

model_training.algorithm: existing measured tabular Q-policy updates only
model_training.neural_candidate_data: source-bound trace transitions, numeric observations and rewards; heldout excluded
model_training.heldout: independent disjoint episode seeds compared with random baseline, observational only for uncontrolled libretro RNG

security.firmware: operator-installed legitimate files only; no key or BIOS acquisition
security.emulator_sandbox: existing fail-closed isolated bubblewrap host, approved immutable library SHA, no unsafe fallback
security.rights: operator rights acknowledgement not independent copyright/legal verification
security.snapshots: actual opaque native state and source identity; never trust request-supplied snapshots as issuer
security.worker_failure: abort without durable false success; incomplete checkpoint not promotion

acceptance_needed: real original ROM generation and boot
per-core approved executable ABI and worker path
independent reverse/boomerang execution on representative native cores
heldout evaluation reproducibility on original ROMs
authorized candidate neural training run and independent model improvement evidence if neural capability is claimed
controlled real-ROM action and multi-core source experiments
actual candidate neural optimizer plus independent heldout accuracy proof
qualification: No real installed core, native ROM session, CI check, neural weight optimization or production promotion executed in this change.

actual_neural_world_model.algorithm: real numeric two hidden tanh layers AdamW and gradient clipping
actual_neural_world_model.source: only exact reconstituted approved rights-declared Q episode receipts
actual_neural_world_model.holdout: disjoint source trace groups, train-only normalization

curriculum.adaptive_priority: verified source evidence from previous ROM runs
